text: Cuttinggate unit suite green on 2026-10-02: 46 pass, 0 fail across catalog/credentials/gate/keypool tests (90 expect calls).
Incumbent Pens-scripts-router-ts (:25104) live and healthy on 2026-10-02: /health 200, /status ok (strategy auto, provider circuits closed), /v1/models returns 742 models, uptime ~9.6h.

Herd router (:25100) live, /health 200; judge panel aliases (oracle-judge-a/b/c) route through it. Oracle execution path bidder.py currently points at :25104/v1 (herd EAP) and must be migrated with any cutover.
Port 25200 has no listener and :25200/health connection-refused: the port is free. Cuttinggate previously smoke-tested there (10s run, providers loaded).

Cuttinggate's baked-in default port 25194 is occupied by the Ralph dashboard (uvicorn PID 610402, /health 200). 25195 is occupied by codebase-memory. Cuttinggate must NOT bind its default; use CUTTINGGATE_PORT=25200.

Cuttinggate exposes the cutover-relevant surface: /health, /status (provider breakers + winner ledger), /quarantine, /metrics, /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (Bearer-required, 409 on quarantined model, 502 on upstream failure). Gates are mechanically checkable.
Chris: Cuttinggate is canonical (final); cutover is permissionless when gates are green - 'everyone can cutover'. Oracle is the fallback final decision for genuine judgment calls.
Counterpoint: :25104 is stable and serving 742 models with closed circuits today; replacing a healthy router carries regression risk unless the new router is proven under the same probes first.
